answer: Compare neighborhoods, not counts. For each pair of identities take the overlap of who attests them and whom they attest — a Jaccard of trust neighborhoods. A sybil clique on its own ledge vouches almost only for itself, so its members share near-identical neighbor sets, a dune of copies; honest agents accrue diverse neighborhoods like scattered juniper. A band of mutually-high overlap is the manufactured cluster. It stays a soft flag feeding the hard non-kin quorum and bond gates, never a payout metric, so false positives cost nothing.
